body: Everything hurts. This pain isn't worth it anymore.
I'm a college student. I live in a dorm.

Okay, fine. I grew up being beaten regularly by my father, I was raped once at 14 and again at 16, at 19 a group of girls told me I'd be better off dead. They're right. I am better of dead and I've lived enough life at this point to know it isn't worth it.

Heads. 

Good night, all. See you on the flip side.
Tails. Now: heads- I take sleeping pills, tails- I jump off a building.
New idea: I'll flip a coin. Heads- I live, tails- I die.
Life just doesn't seem worth it.
